segments.contextAfter: `valueLengthLimits`: The padding and truncating behavior of the unit value, as a bounded range of `Int` values. The lower bound, if any, expresses the minimum number of digits for all units. The higher bound, if any, expresses the maximum. The style applies leading zeros to units with less than the minimum number of digits, and truncates units above the maximum digits. Defaults to `nil`, which applies no minimum or maximum.
